Volume Booster test fixture

Every clip below is generated in the page, so nothing is downloaded and the file works offline. Open the extension popup and drag the slider while one is playing.

1. Plain same-origin audio

A blob URL, which is what MSE players like YouTube and Twitch use.

Expect: boosts, popup reports at least one source boosted.

2. Element added after load

Appended three seconds late, to exercise the MutationObserver.

waiting...

Expect: the source count goes up on its own, and the current level is applied to it without touching the slider.

3. Never added to the DOM

new Audio() that is played without ever being appended, which no DOM scan can find.

Expect: caught by the capture-phase play listener and boosted anyway.

4. Inside an open shadow root

Invisible to document.querySelectorAll.

Expect: picked up by the deep sweep within ten seconds.

5. Same-origin iframe

The iframe runs its own copy of the content script.

Expect: boosts, and the popup counts it in the total.

6. Cross-origin audio without CORS

The dangerous case. Paste any audio URL from another domain that does not send an Access-Control-Allow-Origin header. Needs a network connection, unlike the rest of this page.

Expect: the popup says Boost unavailable and the audio keeps playing normally. If it goes silent, that is the bug this whole design exists to prevent.
